_comment: The reviewer roster: internal id -> current email and display name.
The LEDGER stores the internal id, never the email - ids are permanent and
emails are not, and review_decisions.jsonl is append-only. Change someone's
address here and every past decision still resolves to them.
Each decision also snapshots the email/display as they read AT WRITE TIME,
so history survives this file being edited or lost; that snapshot is
provenance, not the authoritative present-day lookup.
Identity here is ASSERTED, not authenticated - see pipeline/identity.py.
Set $SEFER_REVIEWER to the id of whoever is reviewing.
